name: Pumpkling
description: Pumpklings are animated pumpkins from the Feywild, known for wielding oversized weapons to take down their foes with brutal force. They’re crude, vulgar creatures that love to hide among ordinary pumpkins in a patch, blending in until it’s time to strike.

actions.name: Pumpkling Slash
actions.description: The pumpkling makes a powerful, inaccurate swing at creature with a 2-handed weapon, dealing physical damage. The true hit threshold on this attack is increased by 1.

actions.name: Seed Spitter
actions.description: The pumpkling shoots a high pressure stream of it's seeds at a target within 6 units, dealing physical damage. The pumpkling takes 1d4 true damage from using this attack.

actions.name: Roll Forth
actions.description: The pumpkling tucks in it's limbs and rolls 2 units without provoking reactions. The truehit threshold on it's next Pumpkling Slash action on this turn is increased by an additional 1.

actions.name: Body Slam
actions.description: The Pumpkling slams into a medium or smaller creature in an attempt to knock it off balance, dealing damage. On a success, the creature's first attack on their next turn has a 1d4 penalty.

actions.name: Cannibalize
actions.description: In response to another pumpkling reaching 0 health within 4 units, the pumpkling moves towards them and rapidly eats their remains, gaining 2d6 health.

traits.name: Soft Rind
traits.description: The pumpkling has a very soft outer shell causing it to gain the bleeding condition whenever it takes physical damage.
